description: Cryptographically verify an Ed25519 signature on a stored receipt to confirm it has not been tampered with since signing. Extracts the 12-field signable payload, canonicalizes it, and verifies against the stored public key. Returns verified: true if the signature is valid. Use to audit receipts before using them as evidence or before completing payments based on agent work.

receipt_id.description: The receipt ID to verify — must exist in local storage

name: verify_receipt
